metadata.description: Personal marketplace for tail-claude-mux (TCM) tooling: the branch-pane and peer-session plugins.

plugins.name: branch-pane
plugins.description: /branch opens a fork of this conversation in a new tmux window and leaves this session running.

plugins.name: peer-session
plugins.description: Start Claude Code or the pi coding agent in another repository with a written brief and receive its report, or message an agent session that already runs in tmux.
